# Delineating neural contributions to EEG-based speech decoding

## Overview
128-channel EEG recordings during speech production tasks.
Participants produced one of 5 color words (green, magenta, orange, violet, yellow)
under three speech conditions: overt, minimally overt, and covert.

Each trial consists of 5 repetitions of the same word (1.25 sec per repetition).

## Channel layout (139 channels total)
- Channels 1-128: EEG
- Channels 129-130: DISPLAY (bipolar pair, misc)
- Channels 131-132: MIC (bipolar pair, misc)
- Channels 133-134: EOG (bipolar pair)
- Channels 135-136: EMG upper orbicularis oris (bipolar pair)
- Channels 137-138: EMG lower orbicularis oris (bipolar pair)
- Channel 139: TRIGGER (marks trial onsets)

## Session types
- calibration: Offline data collection for decoder training
- online: Real-time decoding with trained decoder

## Preprocessing note
The EEG channels were recorded with a 10x preamp gain.
Raw values have been converted to Volts (×1e-6).

## Code
Code for data loading, preprocessing, and decoding models is available at:
https://github.com/arayabrain/uhd-gmail-public

## Additional participants (sub-4 through sub-9)
Continuous EEG is stored in float64 EEGLAB files. Event windows are the final 6.25 seconds of the saved 11.25-second raw analysis epochs, located by exact sample matching in the continuous recording. Each window contains five 1.25-second speech repetitions. These are analysis-window timestamps, not independently measured stimulus or acoustic onset times. See run-level events.json. Trailing epochs without word labels are retained in the continuous EEG but omitted from events. Common electrode coordinates are nominal, not participant-specific.

## Subject 3 condition correction (draft)
The 2023-05-23 condition labels in earlier snapshots were reversed. The overt data retained here are subject3-1: backup_calibrated_2 (100 trials) and backup_online_3 (50 trials), both recorded on 2023-05-23. Their EEG recordings, event timing, word labels, and channel annotations are preserved; only the condition labels and BIDS task filenames are corrected.

The 2023-05-23 subject3-2 recordings (backup_calibrated_1 and backup_online_2; correctly minimally overt) have been removed from this draft. Minimally overt analyses use subject3-4 recorded on 2023-05-24: backup_calibrated_2 (100 trials) and backup_online_2 (50 trials). The 2023-05-24 minimally overt and covert recordings are unchanged. Earlier published snapshots retain their original contents.
